title: HelmInputSpec
description: HelmInputSpec is the input specification for the HelmInput transformation.

caCert.description: CACert is used in combination with HelmRepository to specify a TLS root certificate.

caCertFile.description: CACertFile is used in combination with HelmRepository to specify a relative filename for TLS root certificate.

helmRepository.description: HelmRepository specifies the download location of the helm chart. It can either be a URL or an OCI reference.

outputPath.description:
OutputPath is the optional directory path to buffer the blob file.
If empty, a temporary file will be created.

path.description: Path is the path to the directory or tgz file containing the chart on the local filesystem.

repository.description:
Repository is an OCI reference specifying the upload location of the fetched chart.
The reference MUST contain a version tag, and it needs to equal the version of the chart.

version.description: Version is the version of the chart to download from the remote repository.
